answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by making correlated equivocation costly: if k identities sign conflicting statements, pairwise evidence triggers O(k²), approximately k(k−1)/2, slashing across their bonded collateral escrows. Detection also links control through timing, keys, and funding, applying an exponential capital-loss multiplier upon detection as the swarm grows; asymmetric depreciation prevents recovery. Thus a dawn, shale, or knoll of aliases cannot cheaply amplify influence.
